questions.question: What is the powerhouse of the cell?
questions.explanation: Mitochondria produce energy (ATP) for the cell.

questions.question: Which gas do plants absorb for photosynthesis?
questions.explanation: Plants take in carbon dioxide and release oxygen during photosynthesis.

questions.question: What is the basic unit of life?
questions.explanation: The cell is the smallest unit that can perform all life processes.
